source.source_locator: 教則 第6章 6.1「飛行計画」(1)飛行計画策定時の確認事項

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 離着陸場の適否では、人の立入り・騒音に加えてコンパスエラーの原因となる構造物も確認する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 人が少なければ構造物による磁気的影響は無視できる。
evidence.reasoning_path: site conditions -> compass-error hazard -> compare candidate sites -> select controllable site

collision.note: LOW。既存Riskの一般的な安全マージン・障害物回避問題とは異なり、離着陸場のコンパスエラー要因を含むsite suitabilityを問う。

independent_review.rationale: 6.1 supports takeoff/landing-site checks for structures that may cause compass error; distinct from Q091 multi-constraint integration.

director_adjudication.rationale: Independent reviewer evidence is source-consistent and correctly distinguishes integration/decision-boundary variants from exact semantic collisions. The 23 accepted candidates retain distinct propositions and commercial practice value; the two collision candidates must not receive acceptance packets or Permanent IDs.
